$comment: TEST FIXTURE -- the DEPENDENCY-ONLY shape, the one a plugin repository carries: it declares what it needs FROM nen and no `project` block at all, because none of the stacks describes a tree of markdown, one shell script and one JSON contract. Adapted from the hatsu example in zheref/nen#91's proposal. Not shipped; see ../../README.md.

dependency.name: nen
dependency.minimum_semantics: MAJOR.MINOR, interpreted according to the major. See zero_major_caveat -- while nen's line is 0.x this means >=0.1.0 <0.2.0 EXACTLY.

zero_major_caveat.applies_while: the installed and pinned majors are both 0
zero_major_caveat.rule: minimum '0.1' resolves to the range >=0.1.0 <0.2.0. A DIFFERENT MINOR IS OUT OF RANGE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS -- 0.2.0 fails it exactly as 0.0.9 does.
zero_major_caveat.why: SemVer 2.0.0 clause 4: at major version zero the public API is unstable, so at 0.x the MINOR is the breaking-change vehicle.
zero_major_caveat.on_a_higher_minor: Out of range is out of range: re-pin to pinned_ref, exactly as for a lower minor.

dependency.pinned_ref_semantics: The ref the bootstrap installs when the contract is unsatisfied. Never 'latest' -- an unpinned fetch converts a source-pinned supply chain into an unpinned one.
dependency.version_probe_output: A bare semver on stdout, e.g. '0.1.0' -- no 'v' prefix, no other text.

bootstrap.vendoring_forbidden: A vendored copy is a second, unreviewed supply chain that drifts from the manifest it verifies against.

fetch_must_be_two_step.rule: ALWAYS fetch to a file, then run that file. NEVER pipe the script into bash.
fetch_must_be_two_step.why: The script runs under `set -u` and reads ${BASH_SOURCE[0]}; piped into `bash -s --` it dies with an unbound-variable error and exits 1 -- a code that appears in NO table here.

flags.--ref: Required, no default. The tag to pin to.
flags.--source: owner/name to fetch release assets from.

bootstrap.retry_policy: Exit 4 may be retried once. Exits 5 and 6 are NEVER retried -- retrying a checksum failure is how a fail-closed guard becomes fail-open by attrition.

install_paths.absent: Fetch the bootstrap to a file and run it with --ref pinned_ref.

halt.rule: An unsatisfied contract halts the caller. It does not proceed on the version it found.

no_improvised_fallback.rule: There are two install paths and no third. Nothing is downloaded from anywhere else, ever.

no_jq.rule: Read this file, take the literal values, and issue plain curl / bash / nen commands with those literals substituted in.
